rationale: Record authoring-time performance guards that cross these families only through their tools/import-design/**, tools/import-validation/**, tools/templates/**, tools/cmake/** and test/** selectors. check_contracts.py gains a static realtime contract (tools/import-design/realtime_contract.py) that reports React state setters on per-frame paths in agent-authored panel source; the JSX and materialized runtime transforms prepend a one-line @pulp/react runtime revision banner (from packages/pulp-react/runtime-fingerprint.json) ahead of the unchanged bundle; check_vendored_runtime.py and the new pulp_check_vendored_react_runtime() CMake function warn when an app's vendored bundle predates listed runtime fixes; the gain template binds its new output meter through an existing value channel; and verify_create_templates.py plus new tests guard those templates. No importer lowering, DesignIR, capture path, renderer, asset, codegen output, fixture, threshold or Vellum-owned source changes, and no existing test's verdict changes. Registered as watch-only so the families' coverage stays honest about a change that crossed their selectors. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
